Results.ReviewText: First Thanksgiving in nearly 15 years we weren't going to have smoked turkey.  We own two huge smokers, but we are in a rented farm while the house gets renovated 120 miles away.  So, off to Home Depot where the wife spotted the Weber and she said, "Can you smoke with this one?"  (like our 4th Weber in our marriage -- we keep moving and giving them to the new owners.  So tow of the little baskets that the briquets to the side of the bowl and we were off.  Smoked 8 turkey breasts for the day, and everybody raved about the turkey.  WEBER SAVES TDAY
Results.Title: The Weber to the Rescue

Results.ReviewText: Can't tell you how happy I am to own a Weber again! We have just moved to Canada from South Africa and we LOVE to cook on a Weber! Beyond happy that we own another one!

Results.ReviewText: Webber is a well made grill. Easy to assemble with minimal tools. I only cook with charcoal and this grill does the best job. The large cooking surface allows many options for indirect cooking too. I won’t waste money on the cheap knockoffs. You get what you pay for.
Results.Title: Former Owner of Tumbleweeds BBQ Restaurant

Results.ReviewText: I came to post this review because I wanted to brag on my Webber grill.  I purchased this grill 24 yrs ago,  and today (while grilling my 3rd turkey to share),  it finally said,  "I've given you a long life,  but it's time for me to go".  After year round grilling for all these years,  this is the last turkey my old friend will cook for me.  The metal finally ate through where the legs connect.... but even then,  I found a way to finish my last turkey.  I will miss this old girl.  Now to save up for a new baby Webber....because no other brand compares.  RIP
Results.Title: RIP after 24 years

Results.ReviewText: The grill has maintained its popularity over the years for exceptional design that includes an easy removal system for used charcoal, a lower rack for storing charcoal, well placed handles protected from heat, and a strong body.  But, what is even more exceptional is the distribution of heat that results in even cooking and smoking.  Sloped sides and domed top create a flow of heat and smoke that results in even searing and cooking.  Yes, I also have a Weber gas grill that is also fantastic, but when I want that exceptional flavor that comes from grilling over hot coals enveloped in taste enhancing smoke, then my kettle is the desired grill.
Results.Title: Carlsbad Bill

Results.ReviewText: Basic no frills grill with very good quality.  I ended up adding the premium ash dump assembly, thermometer, tool hook handle and the grate with folding sides.  Basically, I added the premium features.  I could have saved a lot of money if I had purchased the premium model to begin with … my bad.  I recommend this grill but the premium has value added features at a good price right out of the box.
